concepts.title: Catalyst
concepts.definition: An event or expected development likely to move a stock within the method trading horizon.

concepts.title: 20-60 Day Time Horizon
concepts.definition: The method mandate for professional-style equity trades.

concepts.title: Self-Sustainability
concepts.definition: The trader must generate and evaluate ideas independently instead of copy trading.

workflow_nodes.title: Data Readiness
workflow_nodes.decision_question: Is the data clean, current, and comparable enough to support the method?
workflow_nodes.description: Captures data collection, cleaning, normalization, and local market-data cache readiness.
criteria: Liquidity and tradability checks are available when market data supports them.

workflow_nodes.title: Macro Regime
workflow_nodes.decision_question: Does the macro regime support the proposed long or short side?
workflow_nodes.description: Uses leading indicators and market context to frame portfolio bias.
criteria: Regime does not directly block the side.

workflow_nodes.title: Sector / Theme Context
workflow_nodes.decision_question: Is the sector or theme aligned with the setup direction?
workflow_nodes.description: Checks whether the ticker has a relevant theme and sector context.

workflow_nodes.title: Fundamental Quantitative Bias
workflow_nodes.decision_question: Do quantitative company metrics support a long or short bias?
workflow_nodes.description: Captures valuation, estimates, outlier, and quantitative processing methods.
criteria: Bias has a reason beyond price action.

workflow_nodes.title: Fundamental Qualitative Bias
workflow_nodes.decision_question: Do qualitative drivers and KPIs support a long or short bias?
workflow_nodes.description: Captures management operating plan, KPI, transcript, and qualitative processing methods.

workflow_nodes.title: International / ADR Workflow
workflow_nodes.decision_question: Does the international macro and ADR setup support a tradeable idea?
workflow_nodes.description: Captures country, sector, PMI, ADR, and pure-play validation methods.
criteria: ADR is exchange-listed rather than OTC.
Country or regional exposure is relevant to the macro setup.
Pure-play exposure is validated before applying country PMI or sentiment.

workflow_nodes.title: Catalyst Window
workflow_nodes.decision_question: Is there a catalyst likely to move the stock within the method horizon?
workflow_nodes.description: Turns bias into a time-bounded trade idea.
criteria: Catalyst belongs inside the trading horizon.

workflow_nodes.title: Technical Timing
workflow_nodes.decision_question: Is price action supportive of low-risk timing?
workflow_nodes.description: Captures trend, range, support, resistance, chart-pattern, and volume confirmation methods.
criteria: Entry timing is favorable or clearly missing.

workflow_nodes.title: Portfolio Construction
workflow_nodes.decision_question: Does the idea fit portfolio exposure, beta, and spread/ratio construction?
workflow_nodes.description: Captures long-short portfolio methods, beta exposure, spread charts, and ratio charts.

workflow_nodes.title: Trade Risk Management
workflow_nodes.decision_question: Is trade-level risk defined before entry?
workflow_nodes.description: Captures stop logic, position sizing, and preventative risk management.

workflow_nodes.title: Process Discipline
workflow_nodes.decision_question: Is the idea being evaluated through the workflow process rather than impulse?
workflow_nodes.description: Captures process, psychology, and discipline methods that prevent forced trades.

workflow_nodes.title: Final Synthesis
workflow_nodes.decision_question: What is the workflow classification after all runnable nodes finish?
workflow_nodes.description: Aggregates node outputs into qualified candidate, watchlist, timing wait, insufficient data, conflict, or reject.
criteria: Long and short evidence are classified separately.
